name: Pobeña
notes: Long left at the western end of La Arena beach, next to the Barbadun river mouth.

name: Ereaga
notes: Sheltered inner-bay beach that only breaks with a big swell; left off the jetty at the south end.

name: Punta Galea
notes: Big-wave right over rock below the Galea cliffs; holds very large swell.

name: La Triangular
notes: Long left and right over sand and rock at the north end of Barinatxe; handles bigger surf.

name: Meñakoz
notes: Heavy big-wave right over boulders in a cliff-backed cove between Sopela and Barrika.

name: Plentzia
notes: Sheltered bay used as a fallback on very big days.

name: La Central
notes: Hollow left over rock in front of the unfinished Lemoiz power plant; bodyboard favourite.

name: Izaro
notes: Big-wave right breaking off Izaro island, reached by boat.

name: Mundaka
notes: World-class long hollow left over the sandbar at the mouth of the Urdaibai estuary.

name: La Isla (Lekeitio)
notes: Left over sand by San Nikolas island at the mouth of the Lea river.

name: Sorginetxe
notes: Sand-bottom peaks near Deba that also turn into a big-wave break watched from the Deba seafront.

name: Orrua
notes: Powerful right over a rock slab in the cove between Zumaia and Getaria.

name: Roka Puta
notes: Big-wave right next to Orrua that starts working when Orrua maxes out.

name: Zarautz
notes: Long consistent beach break and home of a long-running pro contest.

name: Orio (La Antilla)
notes: Left off the Oria river breakwater on big days, more consistent right mid-beach.

name: Hondarribia (El Espigón)
notes: Long right along the Bidasoa breakwater; a big-swell option.

name: Oriñón
notes: Left at the end of the beach needs a strong swell.

name: Laredo (La Salvé)
notes: Only breaks in winter with a big NW swell; peaks at La Playa, Los Pinos and the jetty.

name: La Fortaleza
notes: Long sand-bottom left near the Santoña fort at the mouth of the bay; needs a big NW swell and a long paddle.

name: El Brusco
notes: Powerful hollow peaks at the far end of the beach, a long walk from Noja.

name: Santa Marina (Isla)
notes: Long powerful right over rock on the island off Loredo; holds big NW swell.

name: Somo
notes: Long sandy beach and Spain's first surf reserve; kiting off the beach and in La Poza.

name: Los Peligros
notes: Bay-side kite spot for gusty SW winds; closed to kites in summer.

name: Robayera
notes: Long fast left on the sandbar at the mouth of the Pas river.

name: Los Locos
notes: Cliff-backed beach break with powerful lefts and rights; works on most swells.

name: El Farolillo
notes: Long fast right at the western end of Merón near the San Vicente estuary.

name: Rodiles (La Ría)
notes: Long fast left on the sandbar at the mouth of the Villaviciosa estuary, best at low tide.

name: El Mongol
notes: Right over rock that only works with a big swell, at the eastern end of Gijón's seafront.

name: San Lorenzo
notes: Urban beach; surfers gather around stairs 9 and 10.

name: Luanco
notes: Short hollow right at the church peak; kite riders use the sheltered bay.

name: El Espartal (San Juan de Nieva)
notes: Fast right on the bar at the eastern end of the Salinas arc.

name: Salinas
notes: Long multi-peak beach; hosts an international longboard festival.

name: Playón de Bayas
notes: One of the longest beaches in Asturias; strong currents on big days.

name: Tapia (La Grande)
notes: Historic Asturian surf hub with sand peaks and a left over rock; hosts international contests.
